title: Repository policy (repo_policy.yaml)
description: The policy of one repository, as the hooks and gates of every clone read it: which remote holds the source of truth, which one is a read-only mirror, and which CI context the main branch requires. The file is GENERATED and is never edited in place: its `source` key says where its master copy is. An editor finds this schema through the first line of the file (`# yaml-language-server: $schema=<path or address of this schema>`; a repository that carries a copy of the schema next to the file links it by its relative path); a command-line validator has to be given the path (`check-jsonschema --schemafile <this schema> repo_policy.yaml`). Only the shape that tools rely on is fixed here: any other key is free. Key names are in Spanish because existing readers already depend on them.

oneline.description: A single line: no line breaks (not even in the middle) and no leading or trailing whitespace; inner spaces are fine.

source.description: Where this file comes from: a reference BETWEEN repositories, to the document that describes this repository in the repository that holds its master copy. It is the data equivalent of a darnlink anchored web link: `uuid` is the identifier of the target document (the part that survives a move or a rename) and `url` is the way a reader gets there. It does NOT use darnlink's `ref` type, because that type is for links inside one repository, with a relative path.

uuid.description: The uuid of the target document: 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal, any version, any case.

url.description: Web address of the master copy. Absent when that address is not public information.

fuente_de_verdad.description: The source of truth: the remote that every push goes to.

ci.description: The CI that the main branch requires. Optional: a repository may publish this file without it.

contexto_exigido.description: A single line, or empty (or null).

espejo.description: The read-only mirror: nobody pushes to it by hand.

url_tipica.description: The read-only mirror on GitHub: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>`, with an optional trailing `.git`.

excepciones_temporales.description: The scripts that may still push to the mirror, one by one. `script` is a path relative to the ROOT of this repository.
